properties.reason: Not a bunker: the 29 m2 hole-9 "bunker" on the right half of the fairway (E 537373-537383, N 4291193-4291199, 110 yd from the green) is the floor of a gentle grassy swale (dem_raw: 0.35 m deep over 15 m, no face or lip, unlike the 1 m deep pot by the green) with a dull grey worn patch in the photo; all sources give hole 9 a single bunker, the pot by the green. It is enclosed by fairway, so burned as fairway.
Not a bunker: 12 m2 sliver in the meadow right of the 9th fairway (E 537375-537380, N 4291211-4291220) with no hollow in dem_raw (0.03 m); tan meadow beside a soil mound.

Not a tee: a 2.7 m wide, 33 m long "hole 10 tee" sliver along the top of the barranca bank between the 9th fairway and the ditch (E 537285-537316, N 4291188-4291204), 50 m from any hole-10 tee; it is the bank edge, sloping, not a deck.

Wrong hole: the zoysia apron wrapping the 9th green (short, left and front-left of it, south of the barranca, E 537264-537361) is labelled hole 10 fairway; the 10th tees are west of the green (E 537235-537263) and hole 10 plays away to the SSW, so this is the 9th green surround. Exact geometry of the hole-10 polygon east of E 537264, renumbered. Verified: clipped to the exact hole-10 fairway geometry (no semirough slivers).

Missing 60 m of the gravel path east of the 9th tees (E 537625-537646, N 4291110-4291165): it continues the modelled piece (ends N 4291115) north to the junction with the wide grey track; continuous grey strip in the photo (5 m wide), two shallow parallel edges in dem_raw. Centre line from brightness transects; drawn 4 m wide.

Missing gravel road west of the ditch by the 9th tees (E 537593-537626, N 4291124-4291169): a grey strip 8-12 m wide in the photo running from the north-east corner of the 9th fairway up to the junction where the path above meets the wide grey track; drawn 6 m wide on its brightest core and kept off the fairway.

Holes in the 9th tee deck: the 9th tee is one flat zoysia deck (E 537594-537648, N 4291064-4291098) but the modelled pad had two notches on its north side (E 537603-537638, N 4291073-4291095) labelled hole-8 fairway. A plane fitted to the pad's core in dem_raw (residual 3.5 cm) shows the notches at deck height (median +0.05 m) and the photo is the same uniform pale zoysia, so they are tee 9. Round-2 verification trimmed the proposed convex-hull fill to the deck (ground within 0.10 m of the deck plane): it drops a 22 m2 strip of the NE bank (E 537607-537620, 0.1-0.4 m below the deck). The hole-8 apron outside it is unchanged.
